title: WAMTA program page data (program.yml)
description: Drives the per-year /program page rendered by _includes/program.md. The schedule block has two shapes: kind=timetable (structured grid rendered by _includes/schedule-table.html) or kind=pdf (iframe embed via _includes/pdf-embed.html).

nav_hidden.description: When true, the page stays reachable but is omitted from the top navigation.

intro.description: Intro paragraph (venue, virtual option, etc.). Markdown allowed. The literal 'TBA' is acceptable for placeholder years.

social_events.description: Optional list of social-event links rendered above the schedule. Empty array suppresses the section header.

schedule.description: Either a structured timetable (kind: timetable) or a PDF embed (kind: pdf).

links.description: Optional list of downloadable artifacts (Schedule PDF, Book of Abstracts, etc.) rendered below the schedule.

show_contact.description: When true, renders the contact-us include below the program content.

file_name.description: Display filename used by the iframe fallback.

days.description: Column definitions; each day has a short key (mon/tue/wed/...) referenced by row entries plus the human label rendered as the column header.

rows.description: Row definitions. A row may carry a 'time:' label and either an 'all:' cell repeated across every day OR per-day cells keyed by day-key. Rows without 'time:' (e.g. session-header rows) are valid.

key.description: Short lowercase identifier referenced by row entries (e.g. 'mon').

scheduleRow.description: Row in the timetable. Per-day cells share the row's 'time:' value. Use 'all:' to repeat one cell across every day. Cannot mix 'all:' with per-day cells in the same row.

time.description: Time-of-day label rendered in the bold first column (e.g. '08:00 AM' or 'Evening'). Optional for header-only rows.

all.description: Single cell repeated across every day. Mutually exclusive with per-day keys.

cellMeta.description: Italic single-line text. Used for breaks ('Coffee', 'Lunch'), session sub-headers, 'Closing remarks', etc.

cellKeynote.description: Keynote talk cell. Renders as italic 'Keynote N, Chair: ...' on top of bold speaker + plain title.

cellTalk.description: Regular contributed talk. Renders as bold speaker + plain title.

cellEvent.description: Non-talk scheduled item (Welcoming Remarks, Discussion, Reception, Tour, Banquet, etc.).

note.description: Optional parenthetical note (rendered as ' (<note>)'). Use for venue, address, or duration.

cellSchedule.description:
Multi-line cell where each item is rendered on its own line separated by
. Use for evening sequences (bus, banquet, return bus).
